title: Fix actor bindings and repair creation flows for posts, polls, groups, and pages

requirements.text: Audit and fix the backend actor initialization in useActor.ts-dependent hooks inside useQueries.ts to ensure the actor is always properly instantiated before any mutation or query is called. Guard all backend calls so they wait for a valid actor instance and do not proceed with undefined/null actor.

quotes: unable to create post polls unable to creare groups pages , actor not functioon duisplays

acceptanceCriteria: No 'actor not found' or actor-related error messages appear anywhere in the UI
All mutations (createPost, createPoll, createGroup, createPage) correctly await a valid actor before executing
If the actor is not yet available, mutations show a loading state rather than an error

requirements.text: Fix the post creation flow so that submitting a new post via CreatePostCard, QuickPostBar, CreateGroupPostModal, and SharePage successfully calls the backend createPost method and the new post appears in the feed without errors.
acceptanceCriteria: Authenticated users can create a text-only post and see it appear in the home feed
Authenticated users can create a post with an image or video attachment
No actor or canister errors are thrown during post creation
After successful creation, the post feed is invalidated and refreshed

requirements.text: Fix the poll creation flow so that submitting a new poll via CreatePollPage and any poll creation modal correctly calls the backend createPoll method and the new poll appears in PollsPage without errors.
acceptanceCriteria: Authenticated users can create a poll with a question and at least two options
The created poll appears in PollsPage after submission
No actor or canister errors are thrown during poll creation
Poll voting works after creation

requirements.text: Fix the group creation flow so that submitting a new group via CreateGroupPage and CreateGroupModal correctly calls the backend createGroup method and the new group appears in CommunitiesPage/GroupsPage without errors.
acceptanceCriteria: Authenticated users can create a group with a name and description
The newly created group is visible in GroupsPage and CommunitiesPage
No actor or canister errors are thrown during group creation
After creation, the groups query cache is invalidated and refreshed

requirements.text: Fix the page creation flow so that submitting a new community page via CreatePagePage correctly calls the backend createPage method and the new page appears in PagesPage/CommunitiesPage without errors.
acceptanceCriteria: Authenticated users can create a community page with a name, category, and description
The newly created page is visible in PagesPage and CommunitiesPage
No actor or canister errors are thrown during page creation
After creation, the pages query cache is invalidated and refreshed

requirements.text: Remove or suppress all raw actor error messages currently displayed in the UI. Replace any raw canister/actor error display with user-friendly error messages using the existing backendErrors.ts utilities. Errors should be shown as dismissible toast notifications or inline form errors, not as raw technical strings.
acceptanceCriteria: No raw actor, canister, or principal error strings are visible to end users
All backend errors are translated through backendErrors.ts to user-friendly messages
Error states are shown as dismissible notifications or inline form messages

requirements.text: Ensure the Motoko backend actor exposes all required update methods for createPost, createPoll, createGroup, and createPage with correct parameter types matching the frontend Candid interface. Verify that the actor interface in main.mo is consistent with what the frontend expects in useQueries.ts.

quotes: Fix actor binding errors causing posts, polls, groups, and pages creation to fail

acceptanceCriteria: Backend actor exposes createPost, createPoll, createGroup, and createPage as callable update methods
Method signatures match the Candid types expected by the frontend hooks
Backend compiles without errors after changes

constraints: Do not modify files listed in frontend.immutablePaths (useInternetIdentity.ts, useActor.ts, main.tsx, ui components)
Preserve all existing stable state in the backend — do not reset or wipe stored data
Use backendErrors.ts for all user-facing error message formatting
nonGoals: Adding new features beyond fixing the broken creation flows
Changing authentication flow or Internet Identity integration
